text: #769, built by hand for ask3d's pilot. Refines #742's watcher configuration under D-0403. The watcher and check-repository prepare configured dependencies for the Docker host's own Linux platform, linux/ plus the host's architecture: linux/arm64 on Apple silicon, and linux/amd64 on CI's runners, so CI is unchanged. Pinned bases are multi-platform digests, and with Docker's containerd image store an inspection without a platform reports the host's variant, so preparing linux/amd64 on an arm64 host refused the base even after pulling it; emulation would be slower too. Factory builds on this Mac therefore check on arm64 and the gate checks the same pull request on amd64.
